exposure: Transplantation of fetal pig segmental intestinal tissue (segmental grafts)
Transplantation of spheroids created by in-vitro reaggregation of dissociated fetal intestinal cells
outcome: Degree of maturation and development of intestinal tissue
Maturity of inner circular and outer longitudinal muscles
cohort: Fetal pig small intestinal tissue and cells were transplanted into immunodeficient mice.
finding: Segmental grafts structurally matured and developed with deeper crypts and more mature smooth muscle layers and enteric nervous systems over time, whereas spheroids created from fetal small intestinal cells could not form layered structures or mature sufficiently.
followup_time: Four and eight weeks after transplantation
